title: Florida community fears radioactive waste pile could threaten many living nearby
summary_full: Residents of Progress Village are increasingly concerned about the environmental and health threats posed by a substantial phosphogypsum stack nearby. This waste contains naturally occurring radioactive materials, raising alarms about radiation exposure and potential water contamination, particularly during storm events. Studies on the stack's effects on local air and water quality have been conducted, and the community is advocating for greater transparency and improved management of this hazardous industrial waste.
